title_ar: حزم Kenney الصوتية (أصوات واجهة ومؤثرات حركية) بترخيص CC0
edition_version: RPG Audio 1.0 (2014); UI Audio 1.0 (2012); Impact Sounds 1.0 (2019-12-19); Interface Sounds 1.0 (2020-02-11)
title: Kenney audio packs: RPG Audio, Interface Sounds, UI Audio, Impact Sounds (CC0)
key_findings: Official asset pages state 'License: Creative Commons CC0' and the bundled License.txt repeats CC0 1.0 with 'free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects'; credit optional.

Packs total 330 short OGG files (50 RPG foley, 100 interface, 50 UI, 130 impact); W2-AUDIO stored a curated 67 (book open/close/flip, doors, creaks, footsteps on stone/wood/carpet, coins, metal latch, glass, cup/plate, knocks, UI clicks/confirm/error/question/tick).
All files are mono/stereo Ogg Vorbis, 0.1–3 s, consistent loudness — usable as-is for a mobile UI sound layer.
athar_applications: Default UI sound set (tap, select, confirm, gentle error, hint question) and diegetic foley for the case-file 'phone-inside-phone' (book/page/door/latch).
Candidate 'aha'/deduction lock-in sound: interface confirmation_001/002 (AUD-0025/0026) pending A/B test.
limitations: Generic Western foley; no culturally specific Arab objects (e.g., brass coffee pots, prayer-free souq sounds) — field recordings fill that gap.
CC0 relies on Kenney being the author of all recordings (asserted, not independently audited).

title_ar: خريطة radio aporee الصوتية العالمية — تسجيلات ميدانية (مجموعة أرشيف الإنترنت) بتراخيص لكل مادة
license: Per item: Public Domain Mark 1.0 (most stored items), CC BY 3.0 (4 stored items); CC BY-SA 3.0 and NC/ND items exist but were NOT stored
title: radio aporee ::: maps — global field-recording sound map (Internet Archive collection 'radio-aporee-maps'), per-item licences
key_findings: Each recording is an Internet Archive item with a machine-readable licenseurl set by the uploader (PDM 1.0, CC BY 3.0, CC BY-SA 3.0, CC BY-NC(-SA/-ND) 3.0) plus GPS coverage, recordist and date.

Arab-region coverage is real but uneven: rich for Tunis, Fes/Meknes, Marrakech, Essaouira, Bahrain, Dubai/Sharjah; thin for Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Oman, Iraq; Beirut items are mostly CC BY-NC-SA (not stored).
Many Arab-city items contain the call to prayer or religious chant; W2-AUDIO filtered titles/descriptions for religious terms and skipped them (brief rule).

W2-AUDIO stored 56 excerpts (20–90 s, re-encoded Ogg Vorbis q3) chosen by an automatic calm-window search (lowest momentary-loudness jump); 11 flagged caution (12–18 LU jumps) and 1 deliberate event cue (clock strike, 28 LU).
athar_applications: Authentic, non-orientalist ambience beds for the fictional cities: al-Marsa (Gulf harbour, fish auctions, palm wind), al-Qantara (river city markets, print shop), al-Atlal (medina crafts, coppersmiths, riad courtyards).
Room tones for archive/library/reading room, server room (digital-verification unit), typewriter + rain (newsroom).
limitations: PDM is a label applied by the recordist, not a CC0 waiver; for recordings made 2004–2025 it functions as the author's dedication but legal certainty is lower than CC0 — commercial use should be confirmed by counsel.
Recordings may contain incidental speech of identifiable people, radios/music, or brand names; not auditioned by ear in this session.
CC BY items require attribution in credits (strings in the register).

title_ar: مؤثرات صوتية بترخيص CC0 من موقع OpenGameArt
title: OpenGameArt.org — CC0 sound submissions used by ATHAR (book page flips, keyboard soundpack, paper SFX, ticking clocks, lock & door, waves, beeps, doorbell, ringtone)
key_findings: Each OGA submission page shows a 'License(s)' field; only pages showing CC0 alone were used (pages with CC-BY 3.0/4.0 or CC-BY-SA, e.g., 'Page Turning Sfx', 'Rain on Window Loop', 'Phone Ring Tone', '9 sci-fi computer beeps', were left out).
robots.txt allows content pages with Crawl-delay 10 and disallows /search/ — discovery was done via web search; fetching respected 10 s gaps.
30 files stored: 6 page flips, 5 typing/keypress, 6 paper handling/crumple/rip, 2 ticking clocks, lock+door, gentle waves, 7 beeps, doorbell, modern ringtone.
athar_applications: Core document foley (page flip, paper unfold, crumple = hypothesis rejected), in-story computer typing, lab instrument beeps, doorbell and smartphone ring for diegetic events.
limitations: CC0 status rests on the uploader's declaration; provenance of some older uploads (2009–2011) cannot be audited.
Quality varies (some 8-bit-style beeps); loudness normalisation needed.

title_ar: عينة صوتية لشفرة مورس عبر الإنترنت (أرشيف الإنترنت)
license: Legacy CC Public Domain (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/publicdomain/) per item metadata
title: Internet Archive item 'IpcwSample' — Morse code (CW) over the internet sample (legacy public-domain mark)
key_findings: 240 s of machine-sent CW Morse tones; a 40 s calm excerpt stored (AUD-0163).
Licence field uses the retired CC public-domain certification URL.
athar_applications: Telegraph/Morse puzzle cue (coded message in a harbour radio room) — complements the missing Commons telegraph recordings.
limitations: Weak provenance (anonymous uploader, retired licence tool) — internal prototyping only until replaced by a CC0/PD-government recording.

title_ar: تسجيلات Musopen لأعمال شوبان (مشروع «حرّروا شوبان») بترخيص CC0
rights_jurisdiction: composition PD worldwide (Chopin d.1849); recording CC0 1.0 waiver
license: CC0 1.0 (item licenseurl; uploaded by Musopen's account)
title: Musopen — 'The Complete Chopin Collection' (Set Chopin Free recordings), Internet Archive item 'musopen-chopin'
key_findings: Item metadata: licenseurl CC0 1.0, creator Aaron Dunn, uploader aaron@musopen.org; ~104 Ogg tracks.

Libre Arts (2013) reported Musopen's campaign promise to release the Chopin recordings under CC0; musopen.org itself returned HTTP 403 to our client so the promise was cross-checked only via the IA item and press.
Stored 11 calm pieces (nocturnes, preludes, waltz, mazurka, cello-sonata largo), full length, re-encoded q3 (24.9 MB).
athar_applications: Optional low-level 'reflection' music for menus, case epilogues and the 'editor's room' — only with a music-off default for some audiences (see SOUND_DESIGN_GUIDE §5).
Western classical piano is culturally neutral-to-foreign for Arab teens; use as placeholder until commissioned Arab-instrument score exists.
limitations: Not Arab music; risk of 'generic mystery' feel. Performer releases are assumed via Musopen's contracts (not inspected).
Some pieces have 17–20 LU internal dynamics (AUD-0124/0127/0131) — compress before use as background.

title_ar: الصندوق الموسيقي الوطني لمكتبة الكونغرس — تسجيلات عربية مبكرة 1913–1925
rights_jurisdiction: US: recordings published before 1923 entered PD 1 Jan 2022 (MMA); 1923–1925 recordings PD by 2026 under the 100-year rule (our arithmetic); outside US: phonogram related-rights and underlying-song status unknown
title: Library of Congress National Jukebox — Arabic-language Victor recordings 1913–1925 (e.g., Nahem Simon, Louis Wardiny, C. Souse, Alexander Maloof)
key_findings: ~60 Arabic-language Victor sides (1916–1921) by Syrian/Lebanese émigré singers (Nahem Simon, Louis Wardiny, C. Souse, Moses Cohen) with oud, qanun and violin; plus two 1913 piano pieces by Alexander Maloof ('A trip to Syria', 'Al-ja-za-yer').

LoC rights note: Jukebox recordings are offered with rightsholder permission and, under the Music Modernization Act, recordings first published before 1923 entered the US public domain on 1 Jan 2022; later ones run 100–110 years.
All Arabic sides are vocal songs; composers/lyricists are mostly not identified, so the PD status of the underlying compositions outside the US cannot be established.
athar_applications: Research reference for a commissioned 'mahjar-era' score; possible diegetic gramophone in a historical archive case IF counsel confirms status.
limitations: NOT STORED: underlying works unidentified; Arab life+50 and EU life+70 status unknown; vocal content would need lyric review (romantic themes common).
Alexander Maloof's death year not found in verified sources (Bothwell 2020 gives arrival in US 1894).

title_ar: شرح قانون تحديث الموسيقى الأمريكي وأثره على التسجيلات الصوتية قبل 1972
title: Copyright Breakdown: The Music Modernization Act (Now See Hear! blog, Library of Congress)
key_findings: Pre-1972 recordings receive 95 years from first publication; pre-1923 recordings' protection ended 31 Dec 2021; 1923–1946 recordings get +5 years; 1947–1956 +15 years; remaining pre-1972 recordings protected until 15 Feb 2067.
athar_applications: Rule of thumb (our arithmetic from the stated terms, to be confirmed by counsel): in the US, recordings first published 1923–1946 are protected 95+5 = 100 years, so as of October 2026 recordings published up to and including 1925 are US public domain; anything later is not — and this applies only in the US.
limitations: US-only; says nothing about the composition, or about Arab/EU related-rights terms for phonograms.

title_ar: أرشيف المؤثرات الصوتية لهيئة BBC (ترخيص RemArc غير التجاري) — فهرسة فقط
license: BBC RemArc Licence (non-commercial: personal, educational, research)
title: BBC Sound Effects archive (RemArc Licence) — catalog only
key_findings: Over 33,000 effects (as of Sept 2024), each under the non-commercial RemArc licence; usable for research, education and personal projects, not commercial products.
The licensing page itself was blocked to our fetcher, so exact clauses (storage, redistribution, educational-company use) were not read.
athar_applications: Reference listening only (e.g., for briefing a sound designer); never shipped in ATHAR builds.
limitations: Not stored: commercial product + unread clauses.

title_ar: واجهة برمجة Freesound: التحميل يتطلب OAuth2 — فهرسة فقط
title: Freesound APIv2 overview (authentication: token for search, OAuth2 for original-file download) — catalog only
authors: Music Technology Group, Universitat Pompeu Fabra
key_findings: All APIv2 use needs a credential; search/metadata accept a token, but downloading original sounds requires OAuth2.
freesound.org/robots.txt disallows the ClaudeBot user agent site-wide, so W2-AUDIO did not fetch Freesound pages at all.
athar_applications: Largest CC0 SFX pool; the owner can register an API key and pull CC0-only sounds (filter license:"Creative Commons 0") in a later, human-run step.
limitations: Licences are per sound (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-NC); each must be checked individually.

title_ar: أصوات وكالة ناسا (أعمال حكومية أمريكية) — فهرسة فقط
rights_jurisdiction: US (17 U.S.C. §105), subject to NASA media usage guidelines
title: NASA audio and ringtones / Sounds from Beyond (US government works) — catalog only
key_findings: The page now points to NASA's SoundCloud and Media Usage Guidelines; the NASA images API returns mostly podcast episodes and launch audio, not SFX.
athar_applications: Low priority: mission-control beeps or radio chatter could serve a science-fair (al-Qafila) case; NASA insignia/voices of identifiable astronauts must be avoided.
limitations: Not stored: little relevant content; SoundCloud distribution not crawled.

title_ar: تسجيلات فرقة مشاة البحرية الأمريكية — فهرسة فقط
title: US Marine Band audio resources (government recordings distributed to schools/libraries) — catalog only
key_findings: The page says recordings are distributed free to schools, libraries and radio stations, 'not for sale' and not for private distribution; it does not state public-domain status.
athar_applications: None: military marches clash with ATHAR's civilian, non-police framing.
limitations: Not stored; band's site returned 403 to curl (WebFetch succeeded).

title_ar: رموز Material من Google
title: Material Symbols (Google material-design-icons repository)
key_findings: Repository LICENSE is Apache 2.0; 41 outlined 24px SVGs stored for investigation UI.
Includes explicit text-direction symbols (format_textdirection_r_to_l).
athar_applications: Primary candidate if ATHAR uses Flutter/Android (native Material Symbols font).
limitations: The npm repackage (@material-symbols/svg-400) is third-party; we stored files from Google's own repo instead.

title_ar: أيقونات Lucide
title: Lucide icons (lucide-static)
key_findings: ISC licence; ~2,170 icons; 37 stored; each SVG carries an @license comment.
athar_applications: Good default for a React/Next web prototype (lucide-react).
limitations: No RTL metadata.

title_ar: أيقونات Phosphor
title: Phosphor Icons (core)
key_findings: MIT licence; six weights incl. duotone; 37 regular SVGs stored including 'detective', 'stamp', 'scales'.
athar_applications: Duotone weight suits evidence-card illustration style.
limitations: No RTL metadata; individual designer names not verified (LICENSE names 'Phosphor Icons').

title_ar: أيقونات Tabler
title: Tabler Icons
key_findings: MIT; ~5,000+ icons; 40 stored incl. text-direction-rtl, music-off, volume-off, rubber-stamp, timeline.
athar_applications: Best breadth for accessibility toggles (music-off, captions).
limitations: No RTL metadata.

title_ar: أيقونات Heroicons
title: Heroicons
key_findings: MIT; ~320 icons; 29 stored; lacks microscope, hourglass, stamp, captions, headphones.
athar_applications: Only if the front end is Tailwind-centric.
limitations: Small set; year of 2.2.0 release taken as 2024 from npm metadata context (not re-verified).

title_ar: أيقونات Fluent من مايكروسوفت مع بيانات الاتجاه من اليمين لليسار
title: Fluent UI System Icons (Microsoft) — incl. per-icon RTL metadata
key_findings: README: metadata.json 'directionType' = unique (distinct RTL/LTR drawings) or mirror; 'singleton' sets the default direction.
~180 SVG files with explicit _rtl names; locale folders (incl. ar) for letter-based glyphs; magnifier direction deliberately unified.
48 SVGs stored incl. RTL/LTR pairs (calendar, bullet list, export arrow, task list).
athar_applications: Reference implementation for ATHAR's own RTL icon rules; source of correctly drawn RTL list/calendar glyphs.
limitations: Large repo; GitHub API access was blocked in-session (raw files only).

title_ar: إرشادات Material للتصميم ثنائي الاتجاه (عكس الأيقونات)
title: Material Design (v1) — Usability: Bidirectionality (icon mirroring rules)
key_findings: Mirror: back/forward navigation, icons depicting forward motion, volume-with-slider, text/list icons; linear time and progress fill right-to-left.
Do not mirror: clocks/refresh/history, search (right-hand handle), physical objects, media playback controls and progress in media, slashes, numbers/charts.
athar_applications: Basis of the mirroring table in SOUND_DESIGN_GUIDE.md §8 and ICON_AND_UI_ASSET_REGISTER.csv.
limitations: Year of the v1 page is approximate (Material v1 launched 2014); m2/m3 pages need JavaScript and could not be read.

title_ar: دليل Codex من ويكيميديا — ثنائية الاتجاه
license: not stated on fetched page (Wikimedia docs usually CC BY-SA)
title: Wikimedia Codex style guide — Bidirectionality
key_findings: Mirror horizontal-direction and list/text-flow icons; never mirror time (clock, calendar), check marks, right-hand objects, media controls.
Some icons need language-specific rather than mirrored versions (question mark differs for Hebrew vs Arabic); numbers stay LTR.
athar_applications: Arabic question-mark (؟) glyph must be a language variant, not a mirrored Latin '?' — relevant to ATHAR's 'question/hint' icon.
limitations: General web UI guidance, not game-specific.

title_ar: أثر الاتساق في التعلم متعدد الوسائط: تقليل الأصوات غير ذات الصلة
title: A coherence effect in multimedia learning: The case for minimizing irrelevant sounds in the design of multimedia instructional messages
key_findings: Two experiments (lightning formation; hydraulic brakes) added background music and/or sounds to a narrated animation; Mayer's later synthesis states that adding interesting but irrelevant sounds and music hurts learning (coherence principle).
Mechanism proposed: extraneous audio competes for limited working memory and distracts from the core explanation.
athar_applications: No continuous music during reading-heavy evidence analysis; sound only where it carries meaning (aligns with Outer Wilds practice [ATH-SRC-0208]).
limitations: Short lab lessons with undergraduates; narration + music overlap is a specific case; contradicted in part by a 2023 meta-analysis (ATH-SRC-2432).

title_ar: أثر الموسيقى الخلفية في المستمعين البالغين: تحليل تلوي
title: The impact of background music on adult listeners: A meta-analysis
key_findings: Global effect of background music ≈ null, but specific effects cancel out: background music disturbs reading and has small detrimental effects on memory, while improving emotional reactions; music tempo drives activity tempo.
athar_applications: Music off (or ducked heavily) on text-heavy screens; music allowed on transitions, epilogues, menus where emotion matters more than reading.
limitations: Adult samples; few studies allowed effect-size calculation (authors' own caveat).

title_ar: أثر الموسيقى الخلفية في المتعلمين: مراجعة منهجية وتحليل تلوي
title: The impact of background music on learners: A systematic review and meta-analysis
key_findings: 47 studies / 71 effect sizes: small positive mean effect of background music on learning (d≈0.31); larger when music is played BEFORE the assessment; small advantage for classical music; age may moderate effects.
Authors argue this challenges cognitive-load-based advice to avoid background music.
athar_applications: Supports short music 'bridges' before a deduction/assessment step rather than during reading; music remains optional and user-controlled.
limitations: Heterogeneous designs; publication bias and quasi-experiments; does not overturn reading-interference findings.
Author given names corrected per Crossref (Efrén de la Mora Velasco; Yuting Chen). [Corrected/Clarified 2026-10-27 by deep-card review]

title_ar: أكثر من شعور: قياس تجربة المستخدم الصوتية في لعبة
title: More than a feeling: Measurement of sonic user experience and psychophysiology in a first-person shooter game
key_findings: Sound on/off had a significant main effect on all self-reported game-experience dimensions (immersion, tension, competence, flow, affect, challenge); music alone showed no main effect but interacted with sound on tension and flow; no effects on tonic EDA/EMG.
athar_applications: Investment in SFX (feedback, foley) matters more than background music for experience; keep SFX on by default even when music is off.
limitations: Fast FPS context, small lab sample; adult players; not narrative puzzle games.

title_ar: صوت الألعاب: مقدمة في تاريخ موسيقى الألعاب وتصميم الصوت ونظريته وممارسته
title: Game Sound: An Introduction to the History, Theory, and Practice of Video Game Music and Sound Design
key_findings: Standard academic reference on interactive/adaptive ('dynamic') game audio and the diegetic vs non-diegetic distinction (bibliographic verification only; content not re-read in this session).
athar_applications: Vocabulary for ATHAR's sound spec: diegetic (in the story world) vs non-diegetic (UI/score) layers.
limitations: Not re-read in session; cited for terminology only.

title_ar: إرشادات إتاحة الألعاب (القائمة الكاملة)
title: Game Accessibility Guidelines (full list)
authors: Game Accessibility Guidelines (collaborative group of studios, specialists and academics)
key_findings: Basic: separate volume controls/mutes for effects, speech and music; never convey essential information by sound alone; subtitles for all important speech, clearly presented.

Intermediate: mono/stereo toggle; captions/visuals for significant background sounds; subtitles available before any sound plays; keep background noise minimal during speech; distinct sounds for key events.
Advanced: limit caption words-per-minute to the target age group; allow narrative/instructions to be replayed.
athar_applications: Defines ATHAR's audio settings panel and the rule 'every sound clue has a visual twin'.
limitations: Practitioner consensus, not experimental evidence; no explicit 'sudden loud sound' guideline (closest: avoid sudden unexpected events).

title_ar: معايير WCAG 2.2: التحكم في الصوت والصوت الخلفي المنخفض
title: WCAG 2.2 Understanding SC 1.4.2 Audio Control (A) and SC 1.4.7 Low or No Background Audio (AAA)
key_findings: 1.4.2 (Level A): audio that plays automatically for more than 3 seconds needs a pause/stop or an independent volume control that can reach zero.
1.4.7 (AAA): prerecorded speech-only audio must have no background, a way to turn it off, or background at least 20 dB below speech (1–2 s sounds exempt).
athar_applications: No auto-playing ambience >3 s without an in-app mute; narrated briefings: ambience ≥20 dB under voice or switchable.
limitations: Web content standard; applied to an app by analogy (also referenced by EN 301 549 for apps).

title_ar: إرشاد إتاحة Xbox رقم 104: الترجمة النصية والتعليقات الصوتية المكتوبة
title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 104: Subtitles and captions
key_findings: Speaker names on change; captions for significant non-speech sounds (e.g., <footsteps>) with direction cues; adjustable background opacity 0–100%; ≤40 characters per line, ≤2 lines; subtitles on by default or selectable before the first audio; text scalable to 200%.
athar_applications: Arabic caption style sheet for sound clues: [صوت خطوات على حجر — يسار] etc.; 40-char limit must be re-validated for Arabic script.
limitations: Latin-script guidance; Arabic line length and diacritics need local testing.

title_ar: انتشار انخفاض تحمّل الأصوات (فرط السمع) لدى المصابين باضطراب طيف التوحد: تحليل تلوي
title: Prevalence of Decreased Sound Tolerance (Hyperacusis) in Individuals With Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Meta-Analysis
key_findings: 67 studies: estimated current hyperacusis prevalence in ASD ≈41% (95% CrI 37–46%) and lifetime ≈61% by interview/questionnaire; ≈27% using objective/observational measures.
athar_applications: Sensory-safe audio mode: compressed dynamics, no sharp transients, master limiter; matters for school deployments with neurodivergent students.
limitations: Prevalence within ASD only; definitions vary; not a game study.

title_ar: الموسيقى والإسلام (مقدمة عدد خاص)
title: Music and Islam (introduction to Contemporary Islam special issue)
key_findings: Bibliographic verification only (no abstract available via OpenAlex): an academic special issue documenting that the permissibility of music is a live, contested debate among Muslims.
athar_applications: Justifies a 'music-off' choice at onboarding and percussion/instrument-light defaults — without assuming every family objects.
limitations: Content not read in session; used only for the existence of the debate.

title_ar: الصراع على المجال العام: ردود فعل إسلامية على موسيقى اليوم
title: Battling over the public sphere: Islamic reactions to the music of today
key_findings: Bibliographic verification only: a study of Islamic reactions to contemporary music in the public sphere.
athar_applications: Background for cultural-sensitivity review of ATHAR's music choices.
limitations: Content not read in session.

title_ar: تأجيل إصدار لعبة LittleBigPlanet بسبب مقاطع قرآنية في الموسيقى
title: Sony: LittleBigPlanet US release moved to week of Oct. 27 (Engadget, 17 Oct 2008)
key_findings: Sony delayed LittleBigPlanet worldwide (US from 21 Oct to the week of 27 Oct 2008) after phrases from the Qur'an were found in a licensed background music track, and apologised.
athar_applications: Hard rule: audit every music/ambience file for Qur'anic recitation, adhan, or religious chant before shipping — even in background layers.
limitations: Journalism; the track/artist not named in this article (other reports name it).
